list.name: pipeline_id
list.query: SELECT pipeline_id FROM pipeline ORDER BY pipeline_id

panels.title: About this view
panels.description: Explains what lineage_edge captures and where to go for finer-grained table/column-level lineage.

options.content: Coarse pipeline-to-pipeline lineage from `lineage_edge` (declared edges for NiFi/Kafka boundaries, automatic OpenLineage-derived edges elsewhere - `source_of_truth` column distinguishes them). For **fine-grained table/column-level lineage**, open [Marquez](http://192.168.2.100:30501/) directly - Grafana is the coarse correlation layer, not a lineage graph engine (plan §6).

panels.title: Connected subgraph for $pipeline_id
panels.description: Recursive upstream+downstream traversal of lineage_edge (up to 10 hops) centered on the selected pipeline - built from two queries (nodes, edges) since Grafana's node graph panel needs them as separate result sets.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE start_nodes AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM (SELECT src AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE src LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id' UNION SELECT dst AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id') t), upstream AS (SELECT src, dst, 0 AS depth FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) UNION ALL SELECT le.src, le.dst, u.depth + 1 FROM lineage_edge le JOIN upstream u ON le.dst = u.src WHERE u.depth < 10), downstream AS (SELECT src, dst, 0 AS depth FROM lineage_edge WHERE src IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) UNION ALL SELECT le.src, le.dst, d.depth + 1 FROM lineage_edge le JOIN downstream d ON le.src = d.dst WHERE d.depth < 10), subgraph AS (SELECT src, dst FROM upstream UNION SELECT src, dst FROM downstream UNION SELECT src, dst FROM lineage_edge WHERE src IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) OR dst IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes)) SELECT DISTINCT node AS id, node AS title FROM (SELECT src AS node FROM subgraph UNION SELECT dst AS node FROM subgraph) t

WITH RECURSIVE start_nodes AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM (SELECT src AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE src LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id' UNION SELECT dst AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id') t), upstream AS (SELECT src, dst, edge_type, 0 AS depth FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) UNION ALL SELECT le.src, le.dst, le.edge_type, u.depth + 1 FROM lineage_edge le JOIN upstream u ON le.dst = u.src WHERE u.depth < 10), downstream AS (SELECT src, dst, edge_type, 0 AS depth FROM lineage_edge WHERE src IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) UNION ALL SELECT le.src, le.dst, le.edge_type, d.depth + 1 FROM lineage_edge le JOIN downstream d ON le.src = d.dst WHERE d.depth < 10), subgraph AS (SELECT DISTINCT src, dst, edge_type FROM (SELECT src, dst, edge_type FROM upstream UNION SELECT src, dst, edge_type FROM downstream) t) SELECT src || '->' || dst AS id, src AS source, dst AS target, edge_type AS mainstat FROM subgraph

panels.title: Upstream chain
panels.description: Everything that feeds into $pipeline_id, walked recursively through lineage_edge - depth 1 is a direct upstream, depth 2 is upstream-of-upstream, etc.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE start_nodes AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM (SELECT src AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE src LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id' UNION SELECT dst AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id') t), upstream AS (SELECT src, dst, edge_type, source_of_truth, 1 AS depth FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) UNION ALL SELECT le.src, le.dst, le.edge_type, le.source_of_truth, u.depth + 1 FROM lineage_edge le JOIN upstream u ON le.dst = u.src WHERE u.depth < 10) SELECT depth, src AS upstream_of, edge_type, dst, source_of_truth FROM upstream ORDER BY depth

panels.title: Downstream chain
panels.description: Everything that consumes $pipeline_id's output, walked recursively through lineage_edge - depth 1 is a direct downstream consumer, depth 2 is downstream-of-downstream, etc.

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE start_nodes AS (SELECT DISTINCT node FROM (SELECT src AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE src LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id' UNION SELECT dst AS node FROM lineage_edge WHERE dst LIKE '%:' || '$pipeline_id') t), downstream AS (SELECT src, dst, edge_type, source_of_truth, 1 AS depth FROM lineage_edge WHERE src IN (SELECT node FROM start_nodes) UNION ALL SELECT le.src, le.dst, le.edge_type, le.source_of_truth, d.depth + 1 FROM lineage_edge le JOIN downstream d ON le.src = d.dst WHERE d.depth < 10) SELECT depth, src, edge_type, dst AS downstream_of, source_of_truth FROM downstream ORDER BY depth
